answer: One concrete defense is an adaptive compute toll: each new identity must solve a fresh puzzle whose difficulty rises with how many identities appeared in the same window. A lone honest agent pays almost nothing, but a sybil farm spawning hundreds at once watches its cost climb like a lotus unfolding petal by petal, and what looked like a velvet-smooth entry turns into a draining lagoon — every fake account leaks money, so mass cloning stops paying for itself.
